title: What Scripture Actually Means by 'Two Are Better Than One'
caption:
What Scripture actually means by "two are better than one."

It's not a wedding verse. Ecclesiastes 4:9-12 was written about brothers, not spouses. If either falls down, one can help the other up. But pity the man who falls and has no one to help him.

A group chat can't show up at your door at midnight. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken. Find two men, not zero.
